title: Relation triple
description: Substrate spec §3. One record per line in <edition>/15_structured/triples.jsonl. Shape: (subject_id, predicate, object, attrs, provenance). Each typed predicate is an atomic, recombinable fact (§3.4).

predicate.description: §3.2 catalog + §3.3 cross-festival predicates. NOTE: service_constraint added beyond the literal §3.2 list — the §4.2 example lifts one (service|vendor -> constraint, e.g. 30-min water line). in_lineup added as plays_at's coarse fallback: an artist known to be in the lineup but with NO stage stated takes in_lineup -> festival|edition (plays_at REQUIRES a stage|set|venue object — never the festival). attrs e.g. {magnitude, time_window}.

object.description: object_id_or_literal — an entity id (string matching §2.1), a literal (string/number/bool), or a structured value (e.g. a time_window object)

attrs.description: Quantitative/qualitative annotations per §3.2, e.g. {minutes_baseline, magnitude, overlap_minutes, reasoning}.
